prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Italian, in her late 40s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 diagonal bands by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 32% of the way down her figure from the top, about 51% of the way down her figure from the top and about 68% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET and VIVID CYAN panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries solid polished white marble fused directly into her own form, natural grey-gold veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING pale marble surface with VIVID golden vein striations. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID DEEP BLACK scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera, her extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.
